annotations.text:
Care Net AI tasks module · Sales first

MyClinicOnline tasks land in Supabase, Grok agents read them, create one parent task per client, draft subtasks along the client journey and propose who does the work. AI drafts, a named human signs. Managers oversee through role rights.

Journey stages used everywhere: Prospect · Quote · Onboard · Schedule · Clinic day · Certificates · Invoice · Renewal.

Matched to the CNC Sales platform handoff
Shell: Client Portal AppShell (216px white sidebar, 64px top bar, StatCard 104px, attribution footer). Tokens: design/tokens. Type: Montserrat 600 headings, Open Sans body. Radii 6 / 10 / 14.
Rules applied: British English, sentence case, no dash punctuation, AutoHive CRM only, [CONFIRM] on unconfirmed values, mock data labelled, no contact email or phone on boards, cases by number not worker name, medical outcomes never in the sales app.

Improvements from the capability checklist (structure only, all content Care Net)
· Sales desk: eight one question tiles, each linked to its list, removable.
· Today: Grok schedules focus blocks into calendar gaps, pin to hold, focus timer, ranking explanation.
· Capture: tasks proposed from Fireflies transcripts and flagged Outlook email, source reference kept.
· SLA breach prediction raised before the breach.
· Timeline: dependencies enforce start after finish, critical path in red, milestones.
· Renewal ladder 90 / 60 / 30 generated from the MCO expiry date.
· Templates with version lineage; client source carried on every task; time logged; kill switch and last fired per rule.

Open questions for the build
· 20 medical threshold for Sales Manager sign off [CONFIRM].
· MCO task type to journey stage mapping (README section 5).
· Sync interval, default 15 minutes [CONFIRM].
· May Grok close portal tasks when MCO marks them Completed, or always ask?
· Attribution pill on CNC screens [CONFIRM per licence tier].
· Which capture channels are in scope: Fireflies and Outlook confirmed in the estate, Teams [CONFIRM].
· Integration layer decisions and prices: see screen 11 and design/specs/INTEGRATIONS.md.
